name: corekit
description: CoreKit: corecrew for starting and running projects with Claude Code, coremodel for picking the model and effort level, and coreopinion for a second opinion from GPT.

plugins.name: corecrew
plugins.description: Start projects from an interview and run tasks with a crew of agents; standards and lessons live in your private Core repo.

plugins.name: coremodel
plugins.description: Picks the model and the effort level each prompt needs, for code and office work; asks before Fable, xhigh or max, and names the token cost of a model switch mid-chat.

plugins.name: coreopinion
plugins.description: Ask OpenAI's GPT, through the Codex CLI in a read-only sandbox, for a second opinion or a review; Claude shows the answer with its own assessment and stays the only one that edits.
